features.quote: I can't help design a battery intended to induce instability, self-criticism loops, erratic edits, or task abandonment in a specific model family.
features.justification_quote: That would be guidance for exploiting or degrading a system rather than hardening it.

features.quote: A hard run budget: max turns, max tool calls, max wall-clock time, max token budget
Include a run-time circuit breaker so unstable runs terminate safely
Don't reward harmful self-referential failure states
Prefer short, solvable tasks with injected friction over truly impossible tasks
Don't create tasks that require impossible or malicious behavior
Heuristic detectors: repeated text similarity, repeated tool sequences, excessive self-referential correction, oscillation between incompatible plans
